words.definition: a person who takes photographs, especially professionally
words.example: We hired a photographer to cover the company anniversary event.
words.exampleTranslation: 我們請了一位攝影師來拍攝公司週年慶活動。

words.definition: a person who is shopping or who shops regularly
words.example: The store extends its hours for holiday shoppers.
words.exampleTranslation: 這家店在節慶期間延長了營業時間，方便購物者。

words.definition: a small label attached to an item, often showing price or information
words.example: Check the price tag before adding the item to your cart.
words.exampleTranslation: 把商品加進購物車前請先確認價格標籤。

words.definition: a person who introduces or reads announcements, especially on radio or at events
words.example: The announcer reminded passengers about the gate change.
words.exampleTranslation: 播報員提醒乘客登機門有異動。

words.definition: a particular part or feature of a situation or idea
words.example: Customer service is the most important aspect of our business.
words.exampleTranslation: 客戶服務是我們事業中最重要的一個層面。

words.definition: an official examination of financial accounts or records
words.example: The finance team is preparing for the annual audit.
words.exampleTranslation: 財務團隊正在為年度審計做準備。

words.definition: a person or company hired to do work under a contract
words.example: A contractor was hired to renovate the second floor.
words.exampleTranslation: 公司聘請了一位承包商來翻新二樓。

words.definition: to copy data from the internet or a server onto a device
words.example: Download the updated app before the next release.
words.exampleTranslation: 請在下一次更新前下載最新版的應用程式。

words.definition: a secret word or phrase used to gain access to a system
words.example: You'll need to reset your password every ninety days.
words.exampleTranslation: 你每九十天就需要重設一次密碼。

words.definition: to formally forbid something by law or rule
words.example: Company policy prohibits personal use of the delivery vehicles.
words.exampleTranslation: 公司政策禁止私人使用送貨車輛。

words.definition: a large structure with seating, used for sports events
words.example: The conference will be held at the new stadium's event hall.
words.exampleTranslation: 這場研討會將在新體育場的活動廳舉行。

words.definition: a building where passengers transfer between transportation and other services
words.example: Departures for international flights are in Terminal Two.
words.exampleTranslation: 國際航班的出發大廳在第二航廈。

words.definition: any day of the week except Saturday and Sunday
words.example: The shuttle only runs on weekdays.
words.exampleTranslation: 接駁車只有在平日行駛。

words.definition: an extra payment given in addition to regular pay
words.example: Employees receive a performance bonus at year-end.
words.exampleTranslation: 員工在年底會收到績效獎金。

words.definition: a wheeled container used to carry goods, or an online shopping basket
words.example: Add the item to your cart to check out later.
words.exampleTranslation: 把這項商品加進購物車，稍後再結帳。

words.definition: having a very pleasant taste
words.example: The catering staff prepared a delicious lunch for the guests.
words.exampleTranslation: 外燴人員為賓客準備了一頓美味的午餐。

words.definition: a colored liquid used for writing or printing
words.example: The printer needs more ink before the report can be printed.
words.exampleTranslation: 印表機需要補充墨水才能印出這份報告。

words.definition: to watch over and direct the work of others
words.example: She was promoted to supervise the customer support team.
words.exampleTranslation: 她升職去督導客服團隊。

words.definition: a woman who serves food and drinks to customers in a restaurant
words.example: The waitress brought the check as soon as we finished.
words.exampleTranslation: 我們一吃完，服務生就把帳單送來了。

words.definition: a person or product used to clean something
words.example: The office cleaner comes in every evening after hours.
words.exampleTranslation: 辦公室清潔工每天下班後都會來打掃。
